	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = illumination_workshop_4
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_books_paper }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_dyes }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_books_paper }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 3 }
	}

}

illumination_workshop_4 = {

	construction_time = construction_time_2_years
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 9
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_4_cost
	character_modifier = {
		monthly_prestige = illumination_workshop_prestige_tier_4
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_dyes
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 4
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_books_paper_production_add = illumination_workshop_books_output_per_dyes_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = illumination_workshop_artisan_tax_per_dyes_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = illumination_workshop_artisan_tax_per_dyes_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}

		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_books_paper }

	}

}
